name: CpeReturnsTracker
tagline: Get every router, ONT and set-top box back – graded, restocked or charged.
description: A complete telecom reverse-logistics app in one Power Apps code component: RMAs with return windows and reminders, courier tracking, a grading bench with A–D grades and faults, restock or recycle rules, unreturned equipment charges after a grace period, refunds for late returns, a returns pipeline board and live KPIs. Drop it on a canvas screen, model-driven form or Power Pages site and it works at once with demo data.
features: 10 drill-down KPIs incl. return rate and refurb yield
Grace period and in-transit protection before charging
Bulk reminders, charges, technician assignment, export
Phone layout with bottom view bar
controlType: standard (2 controls: CpeReturnsTracker data-set + CpeReturnsTrackerPortal Power Pages field control, shared src/app)
